chunks.question: How tall do you have to be for go karting?
chunks.answer: For the main track, drivers must be at least 54 inches tall. For the mini track, riders must be at least 36 inches tall. Closed-toed shoes are required for all go kart riders.

chunks.question: How much does go karting cost?
chunks.answer: A standalone go kart race on the main track is $19.90 and the mini track is $9.90. If you already have a jump pass, add-on races are $9.90 for the main track and $4.90 for the mini track. Each race is up to 10 laps.

chunks.question: Is there a special needs program?
chunks.answer: Yes! We offer a special needs program during all operating hours for $19.90. It includes 120 minutes of play time. One support worker is admitted free with a signed waiver. Go kart races are not included.

chunks.question: What is glow night at Scarborough?
chunks.answer: At AeroSports Scarborough, we have glow in the dark all the time during regular operating hours. The neon lights and glow effects are always on, so you can enjoy the glow experience any time you visit at no extra cost.

chunks.question: Can I host a corporate event or team building activity?
chunks.answer: Yes! We offer corporate and team party packages perfect for team building, milestone celebrations, and employee rewards. Call us at 289-454-5555 or email events.scb@aerosportsparks.ca to customize your event.

chunks.question: Can schools book field trips at AeroSports?
chunks.answer: Absolutely! We welcome school groups, church groups, sports teams, and youth organizations. Minimum 15 people. Call 289-454-5555 or email events.scb@aerosportsparks.ca to book.

chunks.question: Can I rent the whole facility for a private event?
chunks.answer: Yes, we offer full facility rentals. Weekday rentals are $2,000 per hour and weekend rentals are $3,000 per hour. Capacity is up to 220 jumpers with exclusive access to the entire facility including unlimited go karting.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about greeting
chunks.answer: Thank you for calling AeroSports Scarborough! How can I help you today? Use warm, upbeat tone.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about hold
chunks.answer: One moment while I look that up for you. Use when retrieving info.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about transfer_to_human
chunks.answer: Let me connect you with one of our team members who can help you with that. One moment please. Use when the question is beyond what the AI can handle.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about closing
chunks.answer: Thanks for calling AeroSports Scarborough! We look forward to seeing you. Have a great day! Always end on a positive note.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about address_response
chunks.answer: We are at 1120 Birchmount Road in Scarborough. The postal code is M1K 5G4. Speak address clearly and slowly.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about hours_response
chunks.answer: We are open Sunday through Thursday from 10 AM to 8 PM, and Friday and Saturday from 10 AM to 10 PM. Say times clearly with AM/PM.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about price_overview
chunks.answer: Our Premium Jump Pass is $24.90 for 90 minutes, and the VIP Jump Pass is $29.90 for 120 minutes. We also have an All Day Pass for $39.90. All prices are plus tax. Aero Socks are required and cost $3.99 but they are reusable so you can bring them back next time. Give a brief summary, offer to go deeper.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about birthday_overview
chunks.answer: We have three birthday party packages. The Premium Party starts at $39.90 per jumper with 75 minutes of jump time and 45 minutes in a private party room. The VIP Party is $44.90 per jumper with 90 minutes of jump time and 60 minutes of room time. And the Ultimate Party is $59.90 per jumper with 120 minutes of jump time, 60 minutes of room time, plus go karting for every jumper. All packages include pizza and drinks. Minimum 10 jumpers. Would you like more details on any package? Pause between packages for clarity.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about gokart_overview
chunks.answer: We have go karting on two tracks. The main track is for riders 54 inches or taller and costs $19.90 for a standalone race or $9.90 as an add-on if you already have a jump pass. The mini track is for riders 36 inches or taller and costs $9.90 standalone or $4.90 as an add-on. Each race is up to 10 laps. Just remember you need closed-toed shoes for go karting. Mention height requirements clearly.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about booking_redirect
chunks.answer: You can book online at our website aerosportsparks.ca or I can help you with that right now. Would you like to proceed? Guide toward booking.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about waiver_info
chunks.answer: Everyone who enters the park needs a signed waiver, including non-jumpers. You can fill it out online ahead of time at our website to save time at check-in. For anyone under 18, a parent or legal guardian must sign the waiver. Emphasize online waiver to reduce wait times.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about group_booking
chunks.answer: For groups of 15 or more, we offer 25% off with the code GROUPBOOKING25. That brings the price down to about $25.47 per person for 120 minutes including socks. Would you like to book a group visit? Emphasize the savings.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about promo_march_bday
chunks.answer: Right now we have a March Birthday Promotion with up to $150 off birthday parties. Use code MARCHBDAY50 for $50 off a Premium party, MARCHBDAY100 for $100 off a VIP party, or MARCHBDAY150 for $150 off an Ultimate party. You need to book by March 31st and host by September 30th. Only share if promo status is Active.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about camp_overview
chunks.answer: We offer AeroCamp for kids ages 4 to 12. Full day camp runs from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM and costs $69.90 per day or $299.90 for a full week. We also have half-day options for $39.90. Activities include trampolines, games, challenges, crafts, and group activities. Early drop-off from 7:30 AM and late pick-up past 6 PM are available for $10 each. Mention current camp availability if applicable.

chunks.question: Information for phone callers about cannot_answer
chunks.answer: That is a great question. I do not have that specific information right now, but I can have someone from our team get back to you. Can I get your name and phone number? Collect callback info when unsure.

chunks.question: What can I do at AeroSports Scarborough?
chunks.answer: AeroSports Scarborough has tons of activities! We have wall-to-wall trampolines, a ninja warrior course, ninja maze, rock climbing walls, dodgeball, slam basketball, a 360 bicycle ride, giant slides, a jump tower, and go karting. Everything except go karting is included in your jump pass.

chunks.question: How much does it cost?
chunks.answer: A 90-minute Premium Jump Pass is $24.90 and a 120-minute VIP Jump Pass is $29.90. The All Day Pass is $39.90. AeroSports grip socks are required and cost $3.99 but are reusable. All prices are plus tax. Go karting is separate starting at $9.90. Would you like to book?

chunks.question: What age can kids come?
chunks.answer: All ages are welcome! As long as your child can walk, they can jump. Kids under 2 get in free with a paying adult. We also have Toddler Time on Saturday mornings from 9 to 10 AM exclusively for ages 5 and under at $15.90, and one parent jumps free.

chunks.question: Tell me about birthday parties
chunks.answer: We have 3 birthday packages starting at $39.90 per jumper with a minimum of 10 kids. All packages include pizza, drinks, a private party room, a glow t-shirt for the birthday child, and digital invitations. The Ultimate Package also includes go karting, free 30 day pass and free socks for everyone! Want details on a specific package?

chunks.question: Where are you located?
chunks.answer: We are at 1120 Birchmount Road in Scarborough, ON M1K 5G4. You can find us on Google Maps by searching AeroSports Scarborough. Our phone number is 289-454-5555.

chunks.question: Is it safe for my kids?
chunks.answer: Safety is our top priority. We have trained staff, park rules posted throughout, and a 300 pound weight limit on trampolines. All jumpers need a signed waiver. Kids under 10 must have an adult present. Spectators are always free and we have comfy seating and free Wi-Fi for parents.
